reasoning_content: Next, I'll install k3d. Let me check the latest version. The k3d releases are on GitHub. Let me use the install script (non-interactively), or download the binary directly.

action.command: cd /tmp && K3D_VER=$(curl -sS -m 20 https://api.github.com/repos/k3d-io/k3d/releases/latest | grep -o '"tag_name": "v[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4) && echo "k3d=$K3D_VER" && curl -sS -L -m 180 -o k3d "https://github.com/k3d-io/k3d/releases/download/${K3D_VER}/k3d-linux-amd64" && chmod +x k3d && mv k3d /usr/local/bin/ && k3d version

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && K3D_VER=$(curl -sS -m 20 https://api.github.com/repos/k3d-io/k3d/releases/latest | grep -o '\"tag_name\": \"v[^\"]*\"' | head -1 | cut -d'\"' -f4) && echo \"k3d=$K3D_VER\" && curl -sS -L -m 180 -o k3d \"https://github.com/k3d-io/k3d/releases/download/${K3D_VER}/k3d-linux-amd64\" && chmod +x k3d && mv k3d /usr/local/bin/ && k3d version", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Install k3d"}
